meta.title: Task Table demo
meta.description: Installs the Task Table release, seeds two categories with fictional tasks and opens a page with both blocks.
meta.author: jomino151

steps.code:
<?php
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
}
global $wpdb;
$now  = current_time( 'mysql' );
$cats = $wpdb->prefix . 'task_table_categories';

$workshops = task_table_get_default_category_id();
$wpdb->update( $cats, array( 'name' => 'Workshops', 'slug' => 'workshops' ), array( 'id' => $workshops ) );
$wpdb->insert( $cats, array( 'name' => 'Talks and panels', 'slug' => 'talks', 'description' => '', 'sort_order' => 1, 'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now ) );
$talks = (int) $wpdb->insert_id;

$rows = array(
	array( 'Workshop: Intro to Git', 'Onboarding week', 'Example University', '25', 'March 2027', 'Laptops needed', $workshops ),
	array( 'Workshop: Writing a CV', 'Career service', 'Sample College', '15', 'May 2027', '', $workshops ),
	array( 'Panel discussion', 'Career day', 'Sample College', '80', 'April 2027', 'Three speakers wanted', $talks ),
	array( 'Talk: Open source in research', 'Lecture series', 'Test Institute', '40', 'June 2027', '', $talks ),
);
foreach ( $rows as $r ) {
	$wpdb->insert(
		$wpdb->prefix . 'task_table_events',
		array(
			'was_angefragt'   => $r[0],
			'kontext'         => $r[1],
			'name_hochschule' => $r[2],
			'tn_anzahl'       => $r[3],
			'zeitpunkt'       => $r[4],
			'auftragdetails'  => $r[5],
			'wer_macht'       => '',
			'category_id'     => $r[6],
			'archived'        => 0,
			'created_at'      => $now,
			'updated_at'      => $now,
		)
	);
}

wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_type'    => 'page',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_title'   => 'Open tasks',
		'post_name'    => 'open-tasks',
		'post_content' => '<!-- wp:task-table/task-table {"categoryId":' . $workshops . ',"align":"wide"} /-->'
			. '<!-- wp:task-table/task-table {"categoryId":' . $talks . ',"align":"wide"} /-->'
			. '<!-- wp:task-table/new-event-signup /-->',
	)
);
